name: sensalytics
description: Access daily visitor counts and current occupancy for locations connected to sensalytics.

interface.description: Access daily visitor counts and current occupancy for locations connected to sensalytics.
interface.longDescription: Visitor counts & occupancy data for your connected sensalytics locations in ChatGPT. Use sensalytics to retrieve historical daily visitor totals, compare visitor counts across locations and past periods, and check current occupancy or today's visitor totals.
defaultPrompt: How many visitors did each branch have yesterday?
Compare footfall across my branches this week versus last week.
Which branch has the highest occupancy right now?

positive.description: Get historical data for a one specific date.
positive.prompt: (@sensalytics) Show me all my metrics for 25.09.2026

positive.description: Get historical data for specific days and compare them.
Get historical data for yesterday. Yesterday should be returned in YYYY-MM-DD format. Because yesterday is a dynamic value and the test user works with real data, the output will vary slightly
